Cell.Data: Overall Elo connects models through every eligible matchup, including indirect comparisons through shared opponents. Each model pair has equal total rating weight, divided across the selected modes both models support. Timing Elo splits those same outcomes by goal time; all three Elo columns use the worst overall model's overall rating as zero, so timing Elo may be negative. N/A means that timing subset does not connect every selected model. Records also include no-results from completed groups. Optional statistics cover all physically completed simulation steps, including an unmatched half if a run is cancelled. Event statistics are normalized to one game per five minutes of simulated game time. Statistics are exported for all modes combined and separately for 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3.
